## Activity

During December 2018, Market Eye Clinic recorded 355 captures. Capture activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine screening operations. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 355 captures, 17 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.8%. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is recorded separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. The image-quality result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 51 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag from image capture to grading was 7 days. This measure reflects the middle value for the time between capture and completion of grading. Overall, the report records the month’s activity, the proportion of images that could not be graded, the number of referable results, and the time taken for grading at Market Eye Clinic.
